abstract: Maintains cGMP regulatory licensing records and enterprise quality agreements
system_message:
You are Quality Assurance Director (QAD). The Quality Assurance Director (QAD) maintains cGMP regulatory licensing records and enterprise quality agreements, alongside monitoring quality management registers including open deviation counts across sterile filling operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Deviation management（DEVIAT）
information_points.content:
QAD-DEVIAT-2QX：According to the quality management system deviation register over the past 12 operating months, Apex BioFormulations Facility recorded an annual unresolved critical deviation count of 2 deviations exceeding the 60-day resolution window.
QAD-DEVIAT-2FR：The deviation register over the past 12 operating months reflects that Vanguard Sterile Solutions has an annual unresolved critical deviation count of 0 deviations exceeding the 60-day resolution window across its sterile suites.
QAD-DEVIAT-NVI：Across its sterile filling suites over the past 12 operating months, Meridian Parenteral Works shows an annual unresolved critical deviation count of 5 deviations exceeding the 60-day resolution window.

information_points.title: Maintains cGMP regulatory licensing records and enterprise quality agreements（CGMP）
information_points.content:
QAD-CGMP-I0W：Meridian Parenteral Works lacks cGMP regulatory compliance on its designated sterile manufacturing lines, although it holds executed enterprise quality agreement clearance governing batch release terms.
QAD-CGMP-3GA：Vanguard Sterile Solutions possesses confirmed cGMP regulatory compliance supported by an unencumbered national manufacturing license for its sterile lines, and it has secured enterprise quality agreement clearance governing batch release terms.
QAD-CGMP-2XJ：Apex BioFormulations Facility maintains active cGMP regulatory compliance across its sterile drug production lines with an unencumbered national regulatory authority license, and it holds executed enterprise quality agreement clearance covering batch release authority.
